MORNING CLUB — We meet at 7:30 on Mondays. Bring your diary and a ruler.

SCHOOL BUS — The bus leaves at 8:05. It does not wait after the bell.

LIBRARY — We open at 8:15. Please stand in a line to return books.

SCIENCE GROUP — We meet every Thursday. Ask Mr Lee before you join.

LOST — I often leave my blue comb in Room 4. Please give it to the teacher.

SPORTS DAY — The running group starts after lunch. Wear your usual shoes.
